scope: Read-only lifecycle, entity retention and interaction continuity review

initial_host_observation.scope: host observations only; not device/runtime performance

work_mode: Pinned immutable git reads; read-only GitHub owner ref/file inspection in interfaces. Private /tmp outputs only. No local builds, toolchain installs, source writes, new tests, native execution or ref updates.

budgets.telemetry: Unavailable. Targets are planning guidance, not measured or enforced token budgets.

retention: Each complete child report and requested attachment is stored in the lead functions.store before retention acknowledgment and child final completion. /tmp copies are restorable after executor loss.
scope_limits: Source traces and method inventory are distinct from native execution; main-actor serial calls do not establish renderer-thread atomicity; node identity/counts do not measure allocation, RSS, FPS, thermal or device behavior.
integration_owner: Root alone integrates and pushes finish/05-spatial-viewports. Lead may prepare a docs-only commit after receiving latest parent/tree; no ref update.
inheritance: Per parent, all 230 changed paths outside lane05 ownership match inherited main 9e0e2ba. Parent-provided provenance, not a new lane05 outside-scope change or milestone promotion.
per_worker_timings: Not observed exactly; ledger entries use null unless a clock observation explicitly establishes a time.
